overview.title: Admin dashboard
overview.description: Monitor and operate the AutoJob pipeline from a unified workspace. These tools call admin/debug APIs directly and are restricted to ADMIN accounts.

pipeline.title: Pipeline operations
pipeline.description: Quick access to pipeline operation and debugging tools.

crawler.title: Crawler
crawler.description: Collect raw jobs from mock or live sources.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.description: Inspect raw jobs and run normalization.

parser.title: Parser
parser.description: Inspect and process data from collected job pages.

recent.title: Recent raw jobs
recent.description: The latest jobs available in the current data snapshot.
recent.empty: No raw jobs yet. Run a crawler to start collecting job data.

notice.title: Operational note
notice.description: Some admin actions can reprocess existing data. Use them only when you need to verify or refresh results.

crawler.title: Crawler operations
crawler.description: Collect job data from supported sources and review the result of each crawler execution.

mock.label: Development tool
mock.title: Mock crawler
mock.description: Run sample data to quickly verify the crawler and raw job flow during development.
mock.note: The mock crawler does not require a source or limit and can verify the pipeline without depending on an external website.

live.label: Live ingestion
live.title: Live crawler
live.description: Collect jobs directly from a live source with a controlled number of items per execution.
live.note: The system will request up to {limit} jobs from {source}. Successfully collected data will be stored as raw jobs.
live.actionHint: After completion, review the collected data in the Jobs workspace.

output.label: Execution
output.title: Latest execution
output.description: Review the result of the most recent crawler execution.
output.empty: No crawler has been executed in this session yet.
output.running: The crawler is collecting job data...
output.successDescription: {source} added {inserted} new raw jobs to the system.

jobs.title: Job processing
jobs.description: Review raw jobs collected by the crawler. Normalization and embedding run automatically; the reprocessing tools below are intended only for maintenance and recovery.

rawJobs.title: Raw jobs
rawJobs.description: Recent jobs stored by the crawler and automatically forwarded through the processing pipeline.
rawJobs.pipelineHint: New jobs are normalized and embedded automatically. Manual reprocessing should only be used for verification or recovery.
rawJobs.reprocessCompleted: The job has been sent through normalization.

batch.label: Maintenance tool
batch.title: Batch renormalization
batch.description: Re-run normalization for existing raw jobs. This tool does not crawl new jobs and should only be used for verification or data recovery.
batch.guideDescription: Choose the data scope, then define the page and number of jobs to process in each batch. New jobs are already normalized automatically, so this tool is not part of the normal workflow.

guide.sourceDescription: Choose a specific source or All sources to process without filtering by source.
guide.pageDescription: Starts at 0. Page 0 is the first batch and page 1 is the next batch.
guide.sizeDescription: The maximum number of raw jobs processed in a single batch.
guide.forceDescription: Enable only when you need to reprocess data even when the system considers it unchanged.

batch.exampleDescription: ITVIEC · Page 0 · Size 100 → process up to the first 100 ITVIEC raw jobs in that batch.
batch.sourceHint: Limit the batch to a specific data source.

pipeline.normalizationDescription: Normalized data generated from the raw job.
pipeline.embeddingDescription: Vector representation generated from the normalized job.

actions.title: Pipeline actions
actions.description: Run each stage separately so failures are easier to isolate.
actions.normalizeTitle: Run normalization again for this raw job
actions.embedTitle: Create an embedding from the current normalized job
actions.embedRequiresReady: Embedding is available only when normalization is READY.
actions.embedUsesNormalizedId: Embedding always uses the current normalizedJobId.

embeddings.title: Embedding tools
embeddings.description: Inspect vector embedding status for candidates and jobs. Embeddings are normally generated automatically; rebuild tools are intended for verification and recovery.

pipeline.label: Automatic flow
pipeline.title: Embeddings are generated automatically
pipeline.description: Candidate profiles and normalized jobs are automatically forwarded to the embedding step when their data is ready. The tools below are mainly for inspection and recovery.

candidate.title: Candidate embedding
candidate.description: Inspect the embedding generated from a candidate profile and used during matching.
candidate.hint: Use candidateProfileId, not the rawCvId from the uploaded CV.
candidate.empty: Enter a candidate profile ID to inspect its embedding status.
candidate.rebuildDescription: Rebuild only when the candidate embedding is missing, failed or needs to be regenerated after profile changes.

job.title: Job embedding
job.description: Inspect the normalized job embedding used to match jobs with candidates.
job.hint: Use normalizedJobId, not the rawJobId from crawler data.
job.empty: Enter a normalized job ID to inspect its embedding status.
job.rebuildDescription: Rebuild only when the normalized job vector is missing, failed or needs to be regenerated.

parser.title: Parser inspection
parser.description: Inspect how the system reads job listing and detail pages from HTML files available on the backend.

flow.label: Processing flow
flow.title: Parser runs in two steps
flow.description: Read a listing page to extract detail URLs, then parse an individual detail page to inspect the generated job data.
flow.listDescription: Extract detail URLs from a listing page.
flow.detailDescription: Parse job data and create a raw job.

source.label: Parser source
source.description: Choose the parser that matches the HTML structure of the data source.

common.filePathHint: Path to an HTML file accessible by the backend or container.
common.filesystemTitle: The file must exist on the backend
common.filesystemDescription: This is a backend/container filesystem path, not a path to a file on the computer running the browser.

list.label: Step 01 · Listing parser
list.title: Parse listing page
list.description: Read a listing-page HTML file and extract the URLs that point to individual job detail pages.
list.baseUrlHint: Used to resolve relative links in the HTML into complete URLs.
list.chooseHint: Choose a URL to continue to step 02
list.noUrls: Parsing completed, but no detail URLs were found.

detail.label: Step 02 · Detail parser
detail.title: Parse detail page
detail.description: Read the HTML of a specific job page, inspect the extracted fields and review the generated raw job.
detail.detailUrlHint: The original URL of the job page being parsed. You can choose one directly from step 01.
detail.listUrlHint: The listing page where this job was discovered. It can be left empty.
detail.actionHint: A successful result creates or updates a raw job.
detail.aboutDescription: The detail parser reads the HTML using the selected source parser and converts the extracted fields into the system raw-job structure.

hero.description: AutoJob turns your CV into a clear professional profile, understands what you are good at, and surfaces opportunities that make sense for you.

steps.title: From CV to relevant jobs in three steps.
steps.description: You provide the context once. AutoJob does the repetitive filtering so you can spend more time evaluating the opportunities that matter.

one.title: Build your profile
one.description: Upload your CV and let AutoJob structure your skills, experience and professional background.

two.title: Understand the fit
two.description: AI compares your profile with job data and evaluates the signals that actually affect relevance.

three.title: Focus on better matches
three.description: Review ranked opportunities instead of scanning every listing from scratch.

features.title: Less job-board noise. More useful context.
features.description: AutoJob is designed to make the search process easier to understand, not to hide decisions behind a black box.

profile.label: PROFILE SIGNALS
profile.title: Your CV becomes structured context.
profile.description: Skills and experience are organized into signals the matching flow can use consistently.

matching.label: MATCHING
matching.title: Relevance comes before volume.
matching.description: Jobs are compared against your profile so stronger opportunities can rise to the top.

focus.label: FOCUS
focus.title: A shorter list worth reviewing.
focus.description: Spend your attention on jobs with stronger alignment instead of endless manual filtering.

cta.title: Start with your profile. Go deeper after sign in.
cta.description: The public home explains the product. Your CV, matching results and job workspace stay behind your account.

footer.privacy: Your workspace starts after sign in.
